### Overall Notes:
- Knee feeling better at rest. Swelling down slightly today too. Still pain in motion and going below parallel.

### Lower Body:

B1. Kickstand Wall Sit x 30s hold per side x 3 sets, rest 45-60s

B2. Natural Knee Extension x 4-6 reps w/ 2s pause in the bottom x 3 sets, rest 90s

C1. Bent Arm Side Plank + Hip Abduction Raise x 45s hold x 3 sets, rest 30s

- TBH could not hold the abduction for the full 45s after the first set. Had to put the leg down and rest a bit before putting it back up for remainder.
